name: to-teach
description:
Turn a Claude conversation into teaching material you can actually use. to-teach creates complete worksheets, interactive exercises, presentations, and lesson plans tailored to your students’ age, language, and learning goals.

Start with a topic or trusted source material—including PDFs, videos, webpages, images, audio, and text. to-teach transforms it into an editable, classroom-ready resource with clear learning goals, varied activities, and solutions.

Once created, share the material by link or QR code, let students complete it interactively, and review their answers and progress. Prefer paper or another platform? Export to PDF, Word, PowerPoint, H5P, and LMS-compatible formats, or share through Google Classroom.

Trusted by 300,000+ teachers, to-teach bridges the gap between an AI draft and a finished lesson resource—ready to teach online or offline.

_published_faq.name: How do I add to-teach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add to-teach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.to-teach.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the to-teach MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: to-teach provides these MCP tools: get_job_status, start_content_job, start_lesson_plan_job, start_material_job, start_presentation_job, and start_worksheet_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to to-teach?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to to-teach in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
to-teach requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
to-teach is developed by thea GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
